WITH transaction_traders AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, tr.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS td ON td.tradereg = tr.trdref
), transaction_counts AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM transaction_traders
  GROUP BY tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, transaction_count,
         transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS transaction_share
  FROM transaction_counts
)
SELECT tradekind,
       transaction_count,
       transaction_share,
       AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS average_count,
       AVG(transaction_share) OVER () AS average_share
FROM shares;
